description: Sends a 1 second pulse periodically or at sunrise / sunset. Sun times are fetched from the sunrise-sunset.org web service, so the sunrise / sunset modes require internet access. When the service is unreachable, the pulse time is estimated from the last fetched sun time and corrected once fresh data is available.

config.name: Mode
config.description: When the pulse is sent: every interval, at sunrise or at sunset

config.name: Offset
config.description: Shift of the pulse relative to sunrise / sunset in minutes, negative means earlier

config.name: Latitude
config.description: Geographic latitude of the location, in decimal degrees (north positive)

config.name: Longitude
config.description: Geographic longitude of the location, in decimal degrees (east positive)

state.name: Last execution timestamp
state.description: Last execution timestamp in seconds from epoch

state.name: Next execution timestamp
state.description: Next execution timestamp in seconds from epoch

state.name: Next pulse timestamp
state.description: Timestamp of the next pulse in seconds from epoch, 0 if unknown

state.name: Pulse end timestamp
state.description: Timestamp when the active pulse ends, 0 if no pulse is active

state.name: Requested date
state.description: Date of the last sun times request (today / tomorrow)

state.name: Last sun time
state.description: Last fetched sunrise / sunset timestamp without offset, used to estimate the next pulse when the service is unreachable

state.name: Estimated pulse time
state.description: True if the next pulse time is estimated from the last known sun time instead of fetched data

state.name: Last pulse timestamp
state.description: Timestamp of the last pulse in seconds from epoch
